title: Ankhorage TLS
summary: Provides provider-agnostic TLS certificate lifecycle and automation.
purpose: Offer a reusable boundary for certificate issuance, renewal, status, and renewal scheduling.
responsibilities: Provide certificate issuance, renewal, status, and automation capabilities.
Expose TLS CLI and capability-provider entrypoints.
Keep certificate lifecycle operations behind a provider-agnostic package boundary.
boundaries: Does not provide a hosting platform or web-server deployment.
Does not make certificate authority availability or domain control guarantees.
audience: Infrastructure and application operators that automate TLS certificate lifecycle tasks.
useCases: Preflight and issue certificates for configured domains.
Renew due certificates and inspect persisted certificate status.
Enable or inspect daily renewal scheduling.

architecture.role: A provider-agnostic TLS lifecycle library with CLI and capability-provider boundaries.
invariants: TLS operations are exposed through explicit package entrypoints.
Automation scheduling remains an explicit lifecycle capability.

limitations: Certificate authority, domain validation, and host prerequisites are controlled by external systems.
